## What the restaurant serves
Doner kebab, durum, pizza, falafel, burgers, chicken, salads, plates and snacks.
The site identifies Halal options; customers should confirm which items are covered and any supplier or certification details at the restaurant.

## Family and sharing menus
- Family Kebab Menu: 15 EUR — 2 kebabs, 2 portions of fries and 2 drinks.
- Family Durum Kebab: 16 EUR — 2 durum wraps, 2 portions of fries and 2 drinks.
- Chicken Mix Box: 10 EUR — 4 nuggets, 4 wings and 4 chicken strips.
- Doner Mix Box: 7.50 EUR.
These prices reflect the current official site data and can change; use the live menu as the final source of truth.
